question: The phrase "enabling young aspirants to spar with grandmasters worldwide" functions as:
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Identification of the Phrase:***

 
 
• The phrase begins with **"enabling,"** which is the **present participle** form of the verb "enable." In this context, it describes or provides more information about the preceding noun/idea (Digital platforms).
